- Wait for scientific consensus

One reason for this position is that starting assessments now without a validated scientific framework can lead to misleading results and potentially accelerate the deployment of models that may not truly have welfare-relevant states. This early engagement can help identify potential issues and guide the development of more robust and validated assessment protocols in the future.
